## A/P Aging

Set `asOf` (YYYY-MM-DD). `bills` queries every posted Bill dated on or before it. Each bill's `openMinor` (the bill less what has been paid or credited on it) above zero is bucketed by days past due (or past its date): current, 1–30, 31–60, 61–90, over 90. `rows` (`AgingRow`, an internal output shape) groups by `vendorId` with a bill count, sorted by total; `totalOpenMinor` and `billCount` sum them.

The aging ties to its control account: `closes` queries every Month Close through `asOfMonth`, `glMinor` is account 2000's credit balance across them, and `differenceMinor` is open less ledger. `closedThrough` is the latest closed month; when the as-of month is not closed yet the page marks the ledger figure provisional.

```ts
import { OpenBillsReport } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-reports';
```

### Non-goals
No operations and no payment scheduling.

### Example
`Reports/open-bills`, as of 31 December 2026.
attributes.cardDescription: Open vendor bills by age, per vendor, tied to the payables account.
